text:
I built an app to help me develop healthy habits and routines on my computer. IT blocks sites/apps based on a schedule and tracks my activity for later analysis.

I had simpler versions of this earlier but never something comprehensive. It was also my first AI assisted development project. I've been using it personally for around a year. I polished it and released it as an open source project last month. It's specific to Linux (which is my primary platform)

The website is at https://glockerapp.com/

I'd posted this earlier on HN hoping to get some feedback but didn't get any traction https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50349646
